**Claude review** of the whole pull request, at `c94c805`: all 8 files reviewed.

0 finding(s), 0 to fix; 0 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

I found no correctness, security or rules problems in this PR. Drags now stay in local state and commit once on release. The scene callbacks the memoized layer reads (`commitAnnotation`, `addAnnotation`, `removeAnnotation`) are stable `useCallback`s. `select` and `tools.setTool` are the only other callbacks the layer calls. I only confirmed that `setTool` is a plain `useState` setter, so it is stable. I did not open `select`'s definition. Removing `removeAnnotation`'s dependence on the current selection fixes the blur-after-reselect case. The changes stay inside the renderer, so the Electron boundary and package import rules are untouched.

<sub>Claude Sonnet 5.5 · $0.15</sub>
